subject: Your Cofoundaz password was changed
html:
Your password was changed

The password on your Cofoundaz account was just changed and you were signed out of your other devices. If this was you, there is nothing to do.

This wasn't me: reset my password

Or paste this link into your browser:

http://localhost:3000/forgot-password

If it wasn't you, reset your password now.

This is a security notice, so you get it even if you muted other emails.
